findings.description: The constructor no longer sets `self.initial`, so any existing code or subclass that reads `wait.initial` now gets an AttributeError, even though `initial` is only deprecated.
findings.rationale: Trigger: user code reads `strategy.initial` on a wait_exponential_jitter object built with the old or new API. Mechanism: the diff replaces `self.initial = initial` with `self.multiplier = multiplier` and never sets `initial`. Impact: code that worked before the deprecation now raises AttributeError, which a deprecation cycle normally avoids.
